 [REPLAY] Tom Lenehan – Perpetual Thinking at Rockefeller University (Capital Allocators, EP.04) Apr 18, 2022

 Tom Lenehan is the Deputy Chief Investment Officer of The
Rockefeller University, where he helps lead the management of the
University’s $2B endowment.  Rockefeller University is a
unique duck – with a focused mission of improving the understanding
of life for the benefit of humanity.  Founded in 1901, it was
the first institution in the country devoted exclusively to
biomedical research.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
